subTitleDesc.sub_title:
本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交
流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
subTitleDesc.sub_describe:
1找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
2針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
3藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。

description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: Midterm speaking assessment will be based on Unit 7 and 8. The assessment will be conducted in the form of interviews with students.
The final exam will be a paper-based exam covering not only Unit 7 and 8 but also Units 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 11, TED Talk and listening.

1. Students have to complete two reading assignments - each with 30000 words - on Xreading. (15%)
2. Mock TOEIC Post-Test on 6/22 (10%)
3. Quizzes and assignments (20%)
4. Attendance and class participation (15%)

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Attendance & Participation Policy (出缺席規定)
 
                                                                                                Philosophy on Attendance
Language learning is not a spectator sport; it requires active practice and engagement. Therefore, your attendance is not just about fulfilling a credit requirement—it is a matter of respect for your peers, your instructor, and the collaborative learning environment we are building. Frequent absences will not only significantly hinder your own learning outcomes but also disrupt the dynamic of our group activities.
 
                                                                                         The "Active Presence" Requirement
Being in the classroom physically is not enough. To be counted as "present," you must be actively engaged. Arriving more than 10 minutes late, sleeping in class, continuously using your phone for non-class purposes, or doing assignments for other courses will result in an automatic "Unexcused Absence" for the day.
 
                                                                                     Unexcused Absences & Grading Penalties
I understand that life happens. Therefore, every student is allowed four (4) hours of unexcused absences (equivalent to two class meetings) without penalty. You do not need to provide a reason for these two absences.
 
Starting from your fifth (5th) unexcused absence, your FINAL grade will be deducted two (2) points for each missed HOUR.
 
Automatic Failure: If you accumulate 6 class meetings (equivalent to 12 hours) of absences or more - excused and unexcused absences included - over the course of the semester, you will automatically fail the course (receive a failing grade), regardless of your performance on exams or presentations.
 
                                                                                               Excused Absences & Documentation
If you need to request an "Excused Absence" (e.g., for medical reasons, family emergencies, or official university representation), you must provide valid and verifiable documentation (such as a doctor's note with a clinic stamp) through the MyFCU system. Simply telling me you feel unwell without proof is insufficient. If the documentation provided is vague or lacks sufficient proof, I will request a one-on-one meeting with you. I reserve the right to downgrade an insufficiently documented leave to an "Unexcused Absence."
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. Any entry to the classroom after attendance check in the beginning of the class will be marked absence, unless you have
legitimate and special reason according to the school rules. Taking too many leaves will also affect your score for course participation. If you are
absent (including both excused and unexcused leaves) over 12 hours (including 12 hours), missing either midterm or final evaluation, you will
fail the course. 請準時上課。點名後才進教室者該節將以曠課論，除非是因校規規定之重大事故遲到。請假過多也會影響平時成
績。缺課次數(含請假及曠課)12節以上(含12節)，期中考、期末考有缺一個以上，學期總成績一律以不及格論。

2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。

3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration. 
如需請假，學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。

4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。

5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。

6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the quiz date. Relevant documents are required for the application.
No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. You are only
allowed to apply for a make-up quiz at most 2 times in a semester. Only those who have taken leave on the system can apply. Missing quiz due
to late entry to the classroom or unexcused absence won't be accepted for make-up quiz. 若須要補考小考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。小考一學期至多能申請兩次補考，有於系統請假者才可以申請。遲到、曠課一律不接受補考。

7. No allowance for make-up midterm and final exam, unless you have got legitimate and special reason according to the school rules and: 期中考和期末考一律不接受補考，除非為特殊原因或重大事故並：
(1) Notify the course instructor before the evaluation date 於考試日期前事先告知授課教師
(2) Need approval from the course instructor in advance 經授課教師事先同意
(3) Present relevant and official evidence 提出相關正式證明文件
(4) If something emergent happened, please notify within three days of the exam/evaluation and present relevant and official documents. 如重大
事件事發臨時，最晚在考試時間開始三日內告知，並提出相關正式證明文件

8. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward
and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。

9. 本課程從109學年度起，廣泛閱讀的評分將主要依據Xreading系統所累進的字數而定。學生可與授課教師協調，以其他方式進
行廣泛閱讀、檢核其學習成效，但進行方式須符合廣泛閱讀之精神並有客觀閱讀之事實。Starting from the 2020-2021 academic year, extensive reading (ER) will be mainly based on the word count accumulated on the Xreading platform over the semester. An alternative plan proposed by students, if approved by their teacher, may be acceptable. However, the alternative must be in compliance with the tenants of ER. Students need to present evidence to demonstrate that they have met the requirements as agreed to by their teachers.

學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
 
2.Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.
抄襲的定義：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
 
3.Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.
考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
